data.text/markdown:
Spike short: what we're building and what to try next

Why. Chris and Mark have watched liquid, higher-priced stocks spike in the first 15-30 minutes and come back down. Mark's tests find a small edge with a lot of month-to-month noise. The aim of this group is not one magic rule: it is 5-10 explainable edges that hold out of sample and can be traded with our own money first. How. A shared research lab where every idea is a small, testable change: marimo notebooks (the agent and we see the same live state), Polars + DuckDB data, PyBroker parity checks, OpenTelemetry traces of every trade decision, and fast decision models (Jev, CLM-8B) where a rule needs judgement. Anything that survives the holdout gets compiled from the Python lab to Rust/C++ for live use.

data.text/html:
Results so far (Alpaca SIP 1-minute bars, May 2025 - Nov 2026)

  • Chris is right about the damage: 1-2 continuation losers a day (<= -200 bps) do most of the harm.
  • Speed is the clearest tell: tail losers hit +5% a median 5 min after the open, winners in 12.
  • ML ranks but doesn't rescue: LightGBM / CatBoost / TabPFN reach AUC 0.6-0.7 on tail losers, PF only ~0.9-1.0. Kronos and Chronos add nothing reliable on so few pre-entry bars.
  • Keep-or-undo loop: 4 of 10 ideas kept; tune PF 1.49, holdout 0.95-0.97. Part of the gain was fit to the tune period.
  • Matches Mark's read: a small, noisy edge. The biggest open question is the entry: Chris's protected limit at the armed price and 30-second bars, which this lab hasn't modelled yet.
Details: docs/trading/reports/ and the slide deck notebooks/results_deck.py.

Gap map (InfraNodus)

The call transcript, Nov 14 memo, Chris's emails and today's reports were condensed into 255 concepts and 12 topic clusters. InfraNodus calls the structure dispersed: lots of threads, few connections between them. The gaps below are where the conversation hasn't joined two topics yet, which is where new tests come from. The live graph is below. If it shows a login page, the graph is still private: open it in InfraNodus or switch on its public share link first.

Structural gaps (red = clusters on a gap):
  • Trade losses <-> Broker errors
  • Entry modifier <-> Broker errors
  • Continuation issues <-> Market edge
Gateway words: yellow, run, spike, message, tail, interactive, pre, session

Earnings shock + Continuation issues via Market edge Split earnings spikes by shock strength; add relative dollar volume at the spike (thin = short covering, heavy = news continuation); use 10-K/8-K keyword flags as a pre-event veto; tag sector read-through so it does not pollute the no-catalyst bucket. Test: Earnings event, not strong positive, gap 0.25-1.0 ATR, normal relative volume, short, 20 min cover; run year by year on long history.
Minute data + Trade losses via Broker errors Tail losers are decided in the first few 30-second bars, which is when IB throttles and errors. Precompute the shock flag pre-open from Massive so the veto never depends on live IB bars. Test: Skip or size down strong positive earnings shocks pre-open; compare PF with and without.
Profit factor + Entry modifier via Broker errors Run speed (minutes to +5%) as an ATR-scaled gate; red = no entry, yellow = half size, no news = full size; IB never feeds the armed state. Test: Does the red/yellow gate plus run-speed gate lift holdout PF from ~0.95 toward 1.5?

Tools in the kit

Tool What it does here Link
marimo Reactive notebooks the agent can drive live; dashboards, slides, static exports marimo.io
PyBroker Independent backtest engine; reproduced 136/136 trades as a parity check pybroker
Alpaca Free SIP 1-minute bars back to 2016, news from 2026 alpaca.markets
LightGBM / CatBoost / TabPFN Tabular models for "will this short become a tail loser?" LightGBM · CatBoost · TabPFN
Kronos / Chronos-Bolt Price-path foundation models (candles in, paths out) Kronos · Chronos
CLM-8B Picks the option closest to the question in embedding space; reranker for news/filings Hugging Face
Jev Millisecond decision model: yes/no gates, classifiers, scores, kill switches Jev Trading Lab (13 levels) · First-Hour Desk
Lightweight Charts TradingView-style candles for bar-by-bar trade replay tradingview.github.io/lightweight-charts
InfraNodus Text-network gap analysis of notes, news and filings infranodus.com
OpenTelemetry A trace span for every rule decision, so a losing trade can be read step by step opentelemetry.io
Notebooks in this lab: spike_short_dashboard.py (engine + ablations), continuation_loser_detector.py, model_lab.py, trade_replay.py (Lightweight Charts replay), results_deck.py (slides).
